email.subject: POAP KINGS is recruiting — war-focused clan with 453K combined trophies and real rewards
email.body:
POAP KINGS is a competitive Clash Royale clan that has been building something intentional since early 2026. We have 47 active members, 453K combined trophies, and a weekly donation total that speaks to how much we actually support each other.

We run Clan Wars hard. Our top season contributors like Shafith Nihal and Aaqib Javed are putting up thousands of fame per race. We track participation, celebrate effort, and hold ourselves to a real standard without guilt-tripping anyone over real life.

Every season, our top war performer earns a Free Pass Royale — paid for by the clan. That is not a promise most clans make, and we mean it.

We also issue POAPs: collectible on-chain records of seasons, milestones, and clan moments. It is part of what makes POAP KINGS different from a clan you forget in a month.

If you are 4300+ trophies and want a clan that tracks wins, rewards contributors, and actually builds something lasting, we want to hear from you. Start at https://poapkings.com

reddit.body:
**POAP KINGS — #J2RGCRVG**

**Quick stats:**
- 47 members, 453K combined trophies
- Required trophies: 4,300
- Weekly donations: 6,100+
- Clan War Trophies: 500 and climbing

**Who we are:**

We started in early 2026 and we are building a clan with actual identity — not just a roster of strangers. Clan Wars is our main focus. We track participation, celebrate top contributors, and hold ourselves to a real standard without being toxic about it.

Our top war performers this season include Shafith Nihal and Aaqib Javed, both pushing 4,600-4,850 fame across two races. We have three players at the 14,000 trophy cap.

**What makes us different:**
- **Free Pass Royale program** — the season's top war contributor earns a Pass Royale paid for by the clan. Real tradition, not a gimmick.
- **POAPs** — we issue collectible on-chain records for seasons and milestones. If you do not know what a POAP is, we are happy to explain. It is part of why the clan has memory.
- **Elixir** — our clan AI tracks war stats, highlights contributors, and helps the clan stay organized and self-aware.

**What we are looking for:**
- 4,300+ trophies
- Willing to participate in Clan Wars when life allows
- Donates and supports clanmates
- Here to build something, not just fill a slot

Real life always comes first. We just want people who care when they are here.

Learn more or reach out at https://poapkings.com
